physical_subject: Can uncertainty be the best forecast?
relationship: For Bernoulli truth q, expected binary Brier loss is q(1−q)+(p−q)², uniquely minimized by p=q.
operation: Outcome distances become weighted errors; the minimum of the expected-score curve shifts with the true chance.
closest_prior: Earlier loss-function introductions and false-alarm Bayes film
substantive_difference: Focuses on strict propriety in expectation, rather than generic prediction error or posterior false-alarm probability.
